items.title: Is Lockheed Martin (LMT) Below Fair Value After Its $59B Contract?
items.summary: Lockheed Martin stock has delivered an 86.2% total return over the past five years, yet current valuation checks and an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach both point to the shares trading below that intrinsic value by a meaningful margin.
